");background-size:cover;background-position:center center;transform:scale(1.012)}
    .scene::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,4,10,.35) 0%,rgba(0,5,12,.08) 35%,rgba(0,10,18,.06) 56%,rgba(0,10,18,.52) 100%);pointer-events:none}
    #rippleCanvas{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:auto}
    .mist{position:fixed;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;filter:blur(26px);opacity:.32;mix-blend-mode:screen;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(225,239,242,.8),rgba(225,239,242,0) 67%);animation:mistMove 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
    .mist.m1{width:55vw;height:16vh;left:-8vw;top:39vh}.mist.m2{width:70vw;height:14vh;right:-20vw;top:43vh;animation-duration:28s;animation-delay:-8s;opacity:.25}.mist.m3{width:38vw;height:10vh;left:36vw;top:47vh;animation-duration:18s;animation-delay:-4s;opacity:.19}
    @keyframes mistMove{from{transform:translate3d(-4vw,-1vh,0) scale(1)}to{transform:translate3d(8vw,2vh,0) scale(1.12)}}
    .leaf{position:fixed;z-index:4;width:clamp(28px,3vw,58px);height:auto;pointer-events:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.4));opacity:.9;will-change:transform}
    .leaf.l1{left:18%;top:69%;transform:rotate(22deg)}.leaf.l2{left:72%;top:76%;width:clamp(20px,2.3vw,43px);transform:rotate(-41deg);opacity:.67}.leaf.l3{left:48%;top:83%;width:clamp(18px,2vw,38px);transform:rotate(67deg);opacity:.55}
    .page{position:relative;z-index:6;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 88vh,rgba(5,16,27,.88) 106vh,var(--ink) 116vh)}
    .header{position:absolute;z-index:20;top:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding:28px clamp(22px,5vw,74px);font-family:Arial,"Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:11px}
    .brand strong{display:block;font:500 16px/1.35 "Hiragino Mincho ProN","Yu Mincho",serif;letter-spacing:.12em}.brand small{opacity:.66;letter-spacing:.17em}
    .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px}.nav a{opacity:.76}.nav a:hover{opacity:1}.lang{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:8px}.lang a{padding:7px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:20px}.lang a.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);opacity:1}
    .hero{min-height:100svh;display:grid;align-items:center;padding:120px clamp(24px,8vw,130px) 72px;position:relative}
    .hero-inner{max-width:900px;text-shadow:0 2px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.68)}
    .hero .place{font:600 10px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.27em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);margin:0 0 20px}
    .seo-h1{font-size:clamp(13px,1.4vw,18px);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 24px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}
    .hero-poetry{font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,94px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:0;max-width:850px}
    .hero-lead{max-width:650px;margin:28px 0 0;font:400 clamp(13px,1.2vw,16px)/2 Arial,"Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
    .hero-link{display:inline-flex;margin-top:34px;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);border-radius:999px;font:600 11px/1 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;background:rgba(0,12,22,.18);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
    .coord{position:absolute;right:clamp(24px,6vw,90px);bottom:52px;font:10px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.56);text-align:right}.scroll{position:absolute;left:clamp(22px,4vw,58px);bottom:45px;font:9px/1 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;opacity:.58;writing-mode:vertical-rl}.scroll::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:1px;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(white,transparent);margin-top:12px}
    .section{padding:clamp(82px,11vw,150px) clamp(24px,8vw,125px);background:var(--ink)}
    .section.alt{background:#0a1b29}.inner{width:min(1180px,100%);margin:0 auto}.kicker{font:700 10px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.23em;color:var(--cyan);margin:0 0 18px}.section h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,67px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.04em;margin:0}.lead{max-width:760px;margin:34px 0 0;font:400 15px/2 Arial,"Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
    .split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(44px,8vw,120px);align-items:start}.split .right{padding-top:22px}
    .services{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:1px;margin-top:68px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}.service{padding:clamp(30px,4.5vw,54px);background:#091a29;min-height:270px}.service span{font:500 10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.42)}.service h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:400;margin:30px 0 18px;letter-spacing:.04em}.service p{font:400 13px/2 Arial,"Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
    .project-card{position:relative;margin-top:62px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:50px 0 54px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:35px;align-items:end}.project-card h3{font-size:clamp(30px,4.5vw,57px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.35;margin:0 0 18px}.project-card p{max-width:700px;font:400 14px/2 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:0}.project-tag{font:600 10px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-align:right;color:rgba(255,255,255,.48)}
    .works-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:62px}.work{padding:36px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);min-height:260px}.work .num{font:500 10px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--cyan)}.work h3{font-size:25px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;margin:34px 0 16px}.work p{font:400 13px/1.95 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted);margin:0}.work .tag{display:block;margin-top:28px;font:600 9px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.43)}
    .facts{margin-top:58px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.fact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,240px) 1fr;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 0}.fact dt{font:600 11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}.fact dd{margin:0;font:400 14px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
    .contact{padding-top:120px;padding-bottom:130px}.contact h2{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,96px)}.phone{display:inline-block;margin-top:45px;font:300 clamp(28px,4vw,52px)/1 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.32);padding-bottom:12px}.small{margin-top:26px;font:400 12px/1.8 Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--muted)}
    footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px;padding:30px clamp(24px,8vw,125px) 44px;background:#04101a;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font:500 9px/1.7 Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
    .en-only{display:none}
    @media(max-width:800px){.nav a:not(.lang a){display:none}.header{padding-top:22px}.hero{padding-left:24px;padding-right:24px}.coord{display:none}.split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.services,.works-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.project-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.project-tag{text-align:left}.fact{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px}.mist{filter:blur(18px)}footer{display:block}footer div+div{margin-top:12px}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.mist{animation:none}#rippleCanvas{display:none}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="scene" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <canvas id="rippleCanvas" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div class="mist m1" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="mist m2" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="mist m3" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <img class="leaf l1" alt="" aria-hidden="true" src="data:image/png;base64,
